source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Models waiting on their Fight On Death ability, under 05.04.05, remain in play until their unit has made its attacks, or until the phase ends. While waiting, they are on the battlefield for every rules purpose, including, among others:

- abilities of either side can measure distances to them
- models of either side can count them as [visible](vsdata:core-rule/visibility) where it matters
- their datasheet abilities keep working
- Stratagems can target them
- enemy units can stay [engaged](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) with them, which can limit the [opposing player](vsdata:core-rule/active-player-and-opposing-player)'s [pile-in](vsdata:core-rule/pile-in-move) and [consolidation moves](vsdata:core-rule/consolidation-move) in an [overrun fight](vsdata:core-rule/overrun-fight)
